fieldValues.title: Where records beat prose
fieldValues.lede: Each pattern is an ordinary situation, what goes wrong in it, and the mechanism SRS uses.
fieldValues.body: The first four cases are small and invented. Each is a situation that any team keeping knowledge in text will recognise. The cases after them are real, and each one links to something you can open. Where a rule is a repository's own governance and not something the tools enforce, the pattern says so.
